name: HTTP Step
description: One synchronous HTTP call as a Dagster asset -- the Airflow SimpleHttpOperator equivalent. A single request, a status-code (and optional response-field) success check, materialize with response metadata.
author: Dagster Community

outputs.description: MaterializeResult with the response status code, body/JSON, and (when response_json_path is set) the extracted value in metadata

body.label: Body
body.description: Raw request body (e.g. form-encoded). Mutually exclusive with json_body.

json_body.label: Json Body
json_body.description: JSON request body, sent with Content-Type: application/json. Mutually exclusive with body.

success_status_codes.label: Success Status Codes
success_status_codes.description: Status codes treated as success. Leave unset for Dagster's default (any 2xx).

response_json_path.label: Response Json Path
response_json_path.description: Dotted path into the parsed JSON response to check against response_json_success_value (e.g. 'data.status'), and to surface as the 'response_value' metadata entry regardless.

response_json_success_value.label: Response Json Success Value
response_json_success_value.description: When set alongside response_json_path, the call only succeeds if the extracted value, stringified, equals this (in addition to the status-code check).
